sanskrit: manase cetase dhiya ākūtaya uta cittaye | matyai śrutāya cakṣase vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
english: To the mind, to consciousness, to thought, to intention, and to understanding; to wisdom, to learning, and to sight — we pay homage with our oblation.

sanskrit: prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya bhūriretase | sarasvatyā uruvyace vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
english: To the in-breath, to the out-breath, to the diffused breath, to the abundantly seed-bearing; to Sarasvatī of wide extent — we pay homage with our oblation.

sanskrit: mā no hāsiṣur ṛṣayo daivyāsas tanūpāvānaḥ śucayas tapojāḥ | amartyā martyām̐ abhi naḥ sacadhvam āyur naḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhuḥ ||
english: May the divine seers, protectors of the body, the pure ones, born of austerity, not abandon us. O immortals, accompany us mortals; grant us further lifespan to live.

sanskrit: idam id vā u bheṣajam idaṃ rudrasya bheṣajam | yeneṣum ekatejanāṃ śataśalyām apabruvan ||
english: This indeed is the remedy, this is Rudra's remedy, by which they warded off the arrow of single point and hundred barbs.

sanskrit: jālāṣenābhi ṣiñcata jālāṣenopa siñcata | jālāṣaṃ bhadraṃ bheṣajaṃ tasya no dhatta jīvase ||
english: Sprinkle us with the jālāṣa water; moisten us with the jālāṣa. Grant us that jālāṣa, the auspicious remedy, to keep us alive.

sanskrit: śaṃ ca no mayaś ca no mā ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamat | kṣamā rapo viśvaṃ no astu bheṣajam ||
english: May there be ease for us and joy for us; let nothing whatever afflict us. May earth cleanse away disease; may all be a remedy for us.

sanskrit: yaśasaṃ mendro maghavān kṛṇotu yaśasaṃ somo varuṇo vāyur agniḥ | yaśasaṃ mā devaḥ savitā kṛṇotu priyo dātur dakṣiṇāyāḥ syām aham ||
english: May Indra the bountiful make me glorious; may Soma, Varuṇa, Vāyu, and Agni make me glorious. May the god Savitṛ make me glorious; may I be dear to the giver, beloved of the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit: yathendro dyāvāpṛthivyor yaśasvān yathāpa oṣadhīṣu | yathā viśveṣu deveṣv evā deveṣu yaśasaḥ syāma ||
english: As Indra is glorious between heaven and earth, as the waters are among the plants — as he is among all the gods — so may we be glorious among the gods.

sanskrit: accha vayam indraṃ yaśasaṃ yaśobhir yaśasvino haviṣainā vidhema | sa no dadhad rāṣṭram indrajūtaṃ tasya trātre adhivāke syāma ||
english: Glorious ourselves, with glories we approach glorious Indra; we honor him with this oblation. May he establish for us the sovereignty driven by Indra; may we be under his protection, his special pleaders.

sanskrit: eha yātu varuṇaḥ somo agnir bṛhaspatir vasubhir eha yātu | asya śriyam abhisaṃyāta sarva ugrasya cettuḥ saṃmanasaḥ sajātāḥ ||
english: Let Varuṇa come here; let Soma, Agni, and Bṛhaspati come here together with the Vasus. O kinsmen, all of one mind, come together to share the glory of this fierce and discerning one.

sanskrit: eha yāta māpa yātādhy asmat pūṣā vaḥ parastād apathaṃ kṛṇotu | vāstoṣpatir anu vo 'yam ahvan mayi sajātā ramatir vo astu ||
english: Come here, do not depart from us. May Pūṣan make for you a pathless way if you go beyond. The lord of the homestead has called you here; may your delight, O kinsmen, rest in me.

sanskrit: yo vaḥ śuṣmo hṛdayeṣv antar yā ākūtir manasi praviṣṭā | tāñ chrevayāmi haviṣā ghṛtena mayi sajātā ramatir vo astu ||
english: Whatever vigor is within your hearts, whatever intention has entered your minds — that I attune with oblation and clarified butter; may your delight, O kinsmen, rest in me.

sanskrit: mama cittaṃ prayavasanyutetve- -indrāgnyor iva havam eta sarve | bṛhaspatir vo ni yunaktu mahyaṃ mama vācam ekacittāḥ sacadhvam ||
english: Come to my thought, all of you, at the moment of departure and departure, as to the invocation of Indra and Agni. May Bṛhaspati yoke you to me; be of one mind and follow my speech.

sanskrit: ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi manasā manāṃsi mama cittam upa cittebhir eta | mama vaśe hṛdayaṃ vaḥ kṛṇomi mama yātam anuvartmāna eta ||
english: I seize your minds with my mind; come to my thought with your thoughts. I make your hearts subject to my will; come following in my path, come to me.

sanskrit: māṃ vaś cakṣur gacchatu māṃ prāṇo dhātā padam anu vartma vaḥ kṛṇotu | ye vo mahānta uta ye kumārā mama yātam anu yātebhir eta ||
english: Let your eye come to me, let your breath come to me; may the Dhātṛ make your path follow my footstep. Whether your elders or your young ones — come, following in my path, come with those who follow.

sanskrit: devebhyo adhi jāto 'si somasya sakhā hitaḥ | sa prāṇāyāpānāya cakṣuse 'sya mṛḍa ||
english: You were born above the gods; you are placed as a friend of Soma. As such, be gracious for the in-breath, the out-breath, and the sight of this one.

sanskrit: ayasmaye drupade bedhiṣa id abhihito mṛtyubhir ye sahasram | yamo mahyaṃ punar it tvāṃ dadātu tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
english: You were indeed struck against the iron post, bound by the thousand deaths. May Yama give you back to me; to that god we pay homage with oblation.

sanskrit: yat te devī nirṛtir ābabandha dāma grīvāsv avicṛtyam | tat te vi ṣyāmy āyuṣe balāya- -anamīvaṃ pitum addhi prasūtaḥ ||
english: The bond that the divine Nirṛti has bound upon your neck, the unbreakable fetter — that I loose from you for life and for strength. Being released, eat untroubled food.

sanskrit: namo 'stu te nirṛte viśvavāre ayasmayaṃ vi cṛtā bandham etam | yamena tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna- -uttame nāke adhi rohayemam ||
english: Homage to you, O Nirṛti who possesses all good things; loosen this iron bond. You, being in accord with Yama and the Fathers, cause this one to ascend to the highest vault of heaven.

sanskrit: antardāvāya juhutā sv etad yātudhānakṣayaṇaṃ ghṛtena | ārād rakṣāṃsi prati dahāgne māsmākaṃ tanvam upa tītapanta ||
english: Offer this well into the inner fire, with clarified butter, as the destroyer of sorcerers. O Agni, burn the demons from afar; let them not scorch our bodies.

sanskrit: śarvo vo grīvā aśarīt piśācāḥ pṛṣṭīr vo 'pi śṛṇātv agniḥ | vīrud vo viśvadhāvīryā mṛtyunā sam ajīgamat ||
english: Śarva has broken your necks, O Piśācas; may Agni crush your ribs. The all-potent plant has united you with death.

sanskrit: apiśācaṃ no adharād apiśācaṃ na uttarāt | indrāpiśācaṃ naḥ paścād apiśācaṃ puras kṛdhi ||
english: Make us free of Piśācas below, free of Piśācas above; O Indra, make us free of Piśācas behind, free of Piśācas in front.

sanskrit: indraś cakāra prathamo nairhastam asurebhyaḥ | vṛścāmaḥ śatrūṇāṃ bāhū anena haviṣā vayam ||
english: Indra first made the Asuras handless. We too cut off the arms of our enemies with this oblation.

sanskrit: nirhastaḥ śatrur abhidāsan no astu ye senābhir yudham āyanty asmān | sam arpayendra mahatā vadhena drātv eṣām aghahāro vividdhaḥ ||
english: Let the enemy be handless, powerless against us — those who come against us in battle with their armies. Strike them together, O Indra, with a great blow; let the sin-slayer, piercing them, make them flee.

sanskrit: ava manyur avāyatā- -ava bāhū manoyujā | parāśara tvaṃ teṣāṃ parāñcaṃ śuṣmam ardayārvācīṃ rayim ā kṛdhi ||
english: Let their fury sink down, let their two arms yoked to the mind sink down. O Parāśara, crush their outward-turned vigor; bring the wealth here toward us.

sanskrit: ātanvānā āyacchanto 'syanto ye ca dhāvatha | nirhastāḥ śatrava sthana- -indro vo 'dya parāśarīt ||
english: You who stretch your bows, who draw them back, who shoot and run — stand there as enemies made handless; today Indra has dispersed you.

sanskrit: nirhastāḥ santu śatravo 'ṅgaiṣāṃ mlāpayāmasi | yathaiṣām indra vedāṃsi yūtheṣu vi bhajāmahai ||
english: Let the enemies be handless; we wither their limbs. O Indra, may we divide up their possessions among our herds.

sanskrit: nirhastebhyo nairhastaṃ yaṃ devāḥ śarum asyatha | jayantu satvāno mama sthireṇendreṇa medinā ||
english: The handlessness you gods shoot as an arrow upon the handless — may my warriors conquer with steadfast Indra as their ally.

sanskrit: śamīm aśvattha ārūḍhas tatra puṃsavanaṃ kṛtam | tad eva tasya bheṣajaṃ yat strīṣv ā haranti tat ||
english: The aśvattha tree has climbed the śamī tree; there the rite for begetting a son is performed. That very thing is his remedy — what they bring forth in women.

sanskrit: puṃsi vai reto bhavati tat striyām anu ṣicyate | tad vai putrasya vedanaṃ tat prajāpatir abravīt ||
english: The seed truly arises in the male and is poured into the female. That indeed is the means of obtaining a son — so spoke Prajāpati.

sanskrit: prajāpatir anv amaṃsta sinīvāly acīkl̥pat | straiṣūyam anyatra dadhat pumāṃsam u dadhad iha ||
english: Prajāpati reflected and Sinīvālī fashioned it: placing the female nature elsewhere, and placing the male nature here.

sanskrit: yā oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīr ity ekā
english: "The plants over which Soma is king" — thus one verse [cited by reference].

sanskrit: muñcantu mā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta | atho yamasya paḍbīśād viśvasmād devaduṣkṛtāt ||
english: May they release me from the curse-born sin, and from that which belongs to Varuṇa; and from the snare of Yama, from all evil done against the gods.

sanskrit: yac cakṣuṣā yan manasā yac ca vācopārima yaj jāgrato yat svapantaḥ | somo mā tasmād enasaḥ svadhayā punātu vidvān ||
english: Whatever sin we have committed with the eye, with the mind, or with speech, whether waking or sleeping — from that sin may wise Soma purify me by his sovereign power.

sanskrit: abhibhūr yajño abhibhūr agnir astv abhibhūḥ somo abhibhūr indro astu | abhy ayaṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā yathāsad evā vidhemāgnihotrā idaṃ haviḥ ||
english: Let the sacrifice be all-conquering; let Agni be all-conquering; let Soma be all-conquering; let Indra be all-conquering. So that this one may overcome all battle hosts — thus we offer this oblation at the Agnihotra.

sanskrit: svadhāstu mitrāvaruṇā prajāvat kṣatraṃ madhveha pinvatam | bādhethāṃ dveṣo nirṛtiṃ parācair asmai kṣatraṃ varca ā dhattam ojaḥ ||
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, may there be self-power; swell here the progeny-rich sovereignty with sweetness. Drive hatred and Nirṛti away; bestow upon this one sovereignty, brilliance, and vital force.

sanskrit: imaṃ vīram ity ekā ||
english: "This hero" — thus one verse [cited by reference].

sanskrit: agner iva prasitir asya śuṣmiṇa uteva matto vilapann apāyati | tasmai te aruṇāya babhrave tapurmaghāya namo 'stu takmane ||
english: Like the onslaught of fire his vigor advances, and like one intoxicated he goes away wailing. To you, O Fever — ruddy, tawny, bearing scorching treasure — let there be homage.

sanskrit: namo yamāya namo 'stu mṛtyave namo rājñe varuṇāya tviṣīmate | namaḥ kṣetrasya pataye namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ ||
english: Homage to Yama, homage to Death, homage to King Varuṇa the radiant. Homage to the lord of the field, homage to the sky, homage to the earth, homage to the plants.

sanskrit: ayaṃ yo janān haritān kṛṇoty ucchocayann agninevābhidunvan | adhā hi takmann araso hi bhūyā athā nyaṅ adharaṅ vā parehi ||
english: This one who makes people yellow, burning them up, assailing them like fire — be without sap now, O Fever; depart hence, downward or away.

sanskrit: indro jayāti na parā jayātā adhirājo rājasu rājayātai | carkṛtya īḍyaḥ śaṃsyaś ca- -upasadyo namasyo bhaveha ||
english: Indra conquers; may he not be conquered. The overlord shall rule as king among kings. Being much praised, worthy of invocation, worthy of acclaim — worthy of approach and homage, may he be here.

sanskrit: tvam indrādhirājaḥ śravasyus tvaṃ bhavābhibhūtir janānām | tvaṃ daivīr viśa imā vi rāja- -āyuṣmat kṣatram ajaraṃ te astu ||
english: You, O Indra, are the overlord, famed; you are the overcoming power over people. Rule over these divine peoples; may your ageless sovereignty be endowed with long life.

sanskrit: prācyāṃ diśi tvam indrādhirājā- -odīcyāṃ diśi vṛtrahan dasyuhāsi | yatra yanti śrotyās taj jitaṃ te dakṣiṇato vṛṣabho 'si havyaḥ ||
english: In the eastern direction you are the overlord, O Indra; in the northern direction you are the slayer of Vṛtra and the Dasyus. Wherever the famous rivers flow, that is your conquest; to the south you are the bull, worthy of oblation.
